en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a circular fountain with a nude female statue standing on a central pedestal, water flowing from her hands and around the base. The fountain is set in a manicured garden with low hedges, benches, and large leafy trees in the background. Two people sit on a bench to the left, dressed in mid‑20th‑century clothing. Behind the trees there is a rocky, slightly elevated hillside. The image has the look and proportions of a vintage picture postcard.
